definition.name: No Rest for the Wicked
definition.review_note: Metadata-only Steam build 22928553 / internal build 29466 layout, inspected 2026-10-25. Private reviewed file controls own the loader proxy and three plugin DLLs. File switching is verified; first startup, assembly generation and gameplay remain untested. No manager mutation or certified runtime support is exposed by this pack.

notes: No automatic download/deployment recipe. Importing metadata does not install mods, select a private path, alter a manager database or launch the game.

MelonLoader 0.7.3 plus Build Liberator 1.0.0, Rune Details 1.1.0 and Wicked Menu 1.0-0225 are installed and file-enabled locally. F12 is configured for Wicked Menu. Exact original archives, runtime, hashes, save/config backup, recovery and launcher bindings remain private.
The installation does not add independent 10-20 spell slots, new weapons/spells or a dedicated quick weapon-swap implementation. Other optional candidates and graphics were not installed.
